reason: Operative on 2026-10-14 as amended. Paragraph 1 transferred the administration of the listed overseas World War II military cemeteries, with supplies and cemetery records, to the American Battle Monuments Commission. EO 10087 (effective on signing, December 3, 1949) changed the supplies clause: before, the supplies and equipment were those in excess of the needs of the Department of the Army and requested by the Commission; after, those determined by the Commission to be required for the discharge of its responsibilities under the order. The command to transfer was performed by 1951-12-31 at the latest, but the resulting allocation is the legal basis the Code still cites, so the clause is carried as operative with that disclosure; exact per-cemetery transfer dates are not held.

reason: Terminated by its own terms. As printed in EO 10057, paragraph 3 let the Director of the Bureau of the Budget transfer Army appropriation balances for use before July 1, 1949, so the authority closed at the end of June 30, 1949 (recorded inclusive; the exclusive reading is that it ended when July 1, 1949 began). EO 10087, signed December 3, 1949, rewrote paragraph 3 with a new window ending before July 1, 1950, so the clause (as amended) closed on 1950-06-30 inclusive, again on its own terms; the first end is the June 30, 1949 lapse. Whether any balances were actually transferred is not shown by any held source, so no performance date is claimed; a transfer in either window would only make the end earlier, and the authority could not outlast its stated window.

reason: Operative on 2026-10-14 as amended. The lead paragraph prescribes the regulations and section 1 governs the travel time included as active duty when travel by public transportation is authorized. Before EO 10649, section 1 based time on actual and necessary schedules for the mode used, or on public surface transportation for unauthorized private travel; EO 10649 rewrote section 1 for travel from home to first duty station and EO 12683 rewrote it again so that for travel from home to first duty station and from last duty station to home the time is the allowable travel time for the authorized mode(s), not to exceed actual travel time, computed under uniform Secretaries' regulations. Rewrites continue the clause; the substance changed.
inventory_reason: The dossier held one whole-order clause. The order has four numbered sections that EO 10649 and EO 12683 treat separately (section 2 is later deleted), so the lead paragraph with section 1 is cut out as its own clause by absolute characters of the held text.
